title: Disappointing  box for June
text:
The boxes have been very hit and miss lately.
The "Exclusive" Vader is just the "electrified Vader" Pop just with a different paint job.
The Shirt was okay.
The bottle opener was kind of meh.
and the "mystery figure" was a cool little Vader.
Overall wasnt really that great this time. If the next box is bad I will be canceling my box.
label: neutral
